setup.device_id_hint: device_id: (empty — auto-registered on first client connect)
setup.no_bundle_title: First-time setup — TLS and config required
setup.no_bundle_body: This server cannot start with the binary alone.
setup.no_bundle_step1: 1. On the backup client: Connections → Add connection → enter this server's IP
setup.no_bundle_step2: 2. The client generates config.toml and tls/ (server.crt + server.key)
setup.no_bundle_step3: 3. Copy those files next to backup-server on this machine
setup.public_ip_non_tty: public_ip is local (127.0.0.1). Set your external IP in config.toml and restart.
setup.public_ip_saved_port: Server IP set to {host}:{port} (saved in config.toml)
setup.public_ip_no_localhost: Use your external IP, not 127.0.0.1 or localhost
setup.stdin_error: Could not read input ({detail}). Try again or set public_ip in config.toml.
tls.missing_title: TLS certificate and private key required
tls.missing_body: HTTPS/WSS is mandatory. Place the files from the backup client deploy bundle:
tls.missing_how: On the client: Connections → Add connection (or Renew server certificate) → copy tls/ and config.toml to this server.
tls.expired: TLS certificate expired on {date} (CN: {cn}). Renew from the backup client and restart the server.
